hook: "an-DEHMN": a boy strides straight out through the thorny rose hedge without a scratch, because he is IN DENIM: indemne, unharmed: an-DEMN ≈ IN DENIM
note: Unharmed, unscathed (sortir indemne d'un accident = to come out of an accident unhurt). Hook supplied by the user. Credit: the user's hook ("in denim").

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "boh-ay-MYAN": a free-spirited BOHEMIAN painter in sandals and a paint-spattered smock dabs the tea party onto his canvas: boh-ay-MYAN ≈ BOHEMIAN
note: example sentence replaced with the free-spirited artist sense (no Romani reference): "Mon oncle est un vrai bohémien : il peint toute la journée et dort dans son atelier." / "My uncle is a real bohemian: he paints all day and sleeps in his studio."

room_name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
hook: "SNOB": nose in the air and pinky up, a man with a monocle sniffs at the plain biscuits as if they smelled of old socks: a true SNOB: SNOB = SNOB, the same word and the same sniff
note: hook rewritten to be vivid and literal (monocle man sniffing the plain biscuits). Snobbish, snobby: negative (elle est un peu snob = she's a bit of a snob); also a noun, un/une snob.

room_name: La salle de jeux · The game room
hook: "ay-rah-YAY": a girl shakes her red pompoms for grandpa and yells "HOO-RAY-YAY!" so many times that her voice comes out scratchy; she clutches her sore throat: ay-rah-YAY ≈ HOO-RAY-YAY!
note: hook rewritten to a plain sound-alike (cheerleader yelling HOO-RAY-YAY until her voice goes scratchy). Hoarse, cracked (une voix éraillée); of a surface, scratched or frayed.

hook: "mah-tew-ree-TAY": a calm teen sister spoon-feeds the messy baby in the high chair with a patient smile: what MATURITY: mah-tew-ree-TAY ≈ MATURITY
note: Maturity (la maturité d'un adulte); of fruit or cheese, ripeness.

hook: "ah-dop-TEEF": beaming parents swing their newly ADOPTED little son between them, all three laughing: ah-dop-TEEF ≈ ADOPT-IVE
note: Adoptive, adopted (des parents adoptifs, un fils adoptif); une famille adoptive = a host or adoptive family.

hook: "zhay-nay-TEEK": grandpa, dad and baby all have the same flaming red curls and freckles: it's GENETIC: zhay-nay-TEEK ≈ GENETIC
note: Genetic (une maladie génétique = a genetic disease; le code génétique).

hook: "fuh-MEHL": a mother duck, the FE-MALE, waddles across the terrace with her fluffy ducklings in a row behind her: fuh-MEHL ≈ FE-MALE
note: Female, of animals and plants (une souris femelle, la femelle du canard = la cane); for women say féminin, une femme. Also a noun: la femelle.

hook: "kan-kah-zhay-NEHR": fifty-year-old Aunt JEN dances the CAN-CAN, kicking her leg high in the AIR: a happy fiftysomething: kan-kah-zhay-NEHR ≈ CAN-CA(N), JEN-AIR
note: A person in their fifties, a fiftysomething (un or une quinquagénaire); also an adjective. Quinqua- = five (tens).

hook: "SAN": a rosy-cheeked girl crunches a big red apple in the SUN: so healthy: SAN ≈ SUN
note: Healthy, sound, wholesome (sain et sauf = safe and sound); of an idea or judgment, sound. Opposite malsain.

hook: "vyay-yee-suh-MAHN": grandpa holds up a photo of himself as a dark-haired young man beside his wrinkled smile: VIEIL (old) + -issement = growing old, aging: vyay-yee-suh-MAHN ≈ VIEIL (old) + -ISSE-MENT: aging
note: Aging, getting older (le vieillissement de la population); also of wine, maturing. From vieillir = to grow old.

hook: "ah-kuh-YAHN": a round cook in a white apron flings his arms wide: "AH, COME IN!" so welcoming: ah-kuh-YAHN ≈ AH, C'M-IN!
note: Welcoming, hospitable (une famille accueillante); of a place, inviting.

hook: "byan-veh-YAHN": a kind granny heaps BEANS onto the plate of a sleepy, YAWNING boy, smiling at him gently: byan-veh-YAHN ≈ BEAN, VEH, YAWN
note: Kind, benevolent, caring (un regard bienveillant); from bien + veiller (to watch over).

hook: "mah-LAN": a clever girl stands on a big MELON to reach the cookie jar on the high shelf: so smart: mah-LAN ≈ MELON
note: Clever, smart, cunning (c'est malin = that's clever; ironically, that was smart!); feminine maligne. Medical second sense: malignant (une tumeur maligne).

hook: "ohn-TEUH": caught by his AUNT with chocolate all over his face, a boy hangs his head: "AUNT... UH..." so ashamed: ohn-TEUH ≈ AUNT, UH…
note: Ashamed (être honteux); of an act, shameful, disgraceful (c'est honteux! = it's a disgrace!). From la honte = shame.

hook: "zhew-dee-SYEUH": JUDY the cook tastes the soup first, then adds just one careful pinch of salt: "JUDY SEES, YUH": zhew-dee-SYEUH ≈ JUDY SEES, YUH
note: Wise, sensible, judicious (un choix judicieux = a wise choice).

hook: "ahs-pee-rah-SYOHN": a girl in a toy astronaut helmet stretches up toward a model rocket on the top shelf: her big ASPIRATION is the stars: ahs-pee-rah-SYOHN ≈ ASPIRATION
note: Aspiration, ambition, longing; second sense: suction, inhaling (from aspirer; un aspirateur = a vacuum cleaner).

hook: "an-fay-RYUHR": a small boy can only reach the LOWER shelf, so he sits on the floor with the bottom books: the INFERIOR shelf: an-fay-RYUHR ≈ INFERIOR (lower)
note: Lower (la lèvre inférieure = the lower lip; l'étage inférieur = the floor below); also inferior, worse (inférieur à = inferior to); usually negative of people.

hook: "ahn-gwah-SAHN": a boy reads a scary book by the lamp, his hair standing on end in ANGUISH: ahn-gwah-SAHN ≈ ANGUISH-SAHN
note: Distressing, nerve-racking, scary (une attente angoissante = a nerve-racking wait). From l'angoisse = anxiety, anguish.

hook: "ee-mah-tay-RYEHL": a friendly see-through ghost glides right out through the books: no body, IMMATERIAL: ee-mah-tay-RYEHL ≈ IMMATERIAL
note: Immaterial, intangible, bodiless (le patrimoine immatériel = intangible heritage); unlike English, rarely 'irrelevant'.

hook: "for-MEHL": a librarian in a black tailcoat and white gloves bows and presents a book on a silver tray: very FORMAL: for-MEHL ≈ FORMAL
note: Formal (une tenue formelle); second sense: definite, adamant (je suis formel = I'm positive; une interdiction formelle = a strict ban).

hook: "day-pahn-SYAY": a shopper buried in bags flings banknotes like a cash DISPENSER: "YAY!" she spends and spends: day-pahn-SYAY ≈ DISPENSE-YAY
note: Spendthrift, extravagant with money (il est très dépensier); from dépenser = to spend. Mildly negative.

hook: "ahn-blay-mah-TEEK": a boy holds up a big snow globe of the Eiffel Tower, the EMBLEM of Paris: ahn-blay-mah-TEEK ≈ EMBLEMATIC
note: Iconic, emblematic, symbolic (un monument emblématique = an iconic landmark).

hook: "or-guh-YEUH": a peacock struts into the shop, fans its tail before the tall mirror and admires itself: "OH, GORGEOUS YOU!" So proud: or-guh-YEUH ≈ OH, GORGEOUS YOU
note: Proud in a bad way, haughty, conceited (négatif: l'orgueil = pride, one of the seven deadly sins); for healthy pride say fier.

hook: "ah-trahk-TEEF": a boy holds a giant red horseshoe magnet that ATTRACTS a whole trail of paper clips off the counter: ah-trahk-TEEF ≈ ATTRACT-ive
note: Attractive, appealing (un prix attractif = an attractive price); of a force, attracting. For a good-looking person French more often says séduisant or beau.

hook: "ee-dahn-tee-FYAHBL": among a dozen plain black umbrellas, a girl pulls out hers at once: red with white polka dots, easy to IDENTIFY: ee-dahn-tee-FYAHBL ≈ IDENTIFI-ABLE
note: Identifiable, recognisable (facilement identifiable = easy to spot).

hook: "moh-DEEK": a boy hands over just one small coin for a tiny pencil: a MODEST little price: moh-DEEK ≈ MOD(EST)-IQUE
note: Modest, small, of a sum or price (une somme modique = a small sum); not of people (for a modest person say modeste).

hook: "ah-nah-toh-MEEK": the nurse points at the knee of a life-size skeleton model: an ANATOMICAL lesson: ah-nah-toh-MEEK ≈ ANATOMIC(al)
note: Anatomical (un modèle anatomique); also ergonomic, body-shaped (un siège anatomique).

hook: "ahr-tay-RYEHL": a helper squeezes the rubber bulb and the cuff on grandpa's arm puffs with AIR: checking his ARTERIAL pressure: ahr-tay-RYEHL ≈ ARTERIAL
note: Arterial (la tension artérielle = blood pressure; une artère = an artery).

hook: "tay-rah-peuh-TEEK": a gentle golden dog rests its head on a girl's bed and she smiles again: a THERAPY dog, so THERAPEUTIC: tay-rah-peuh-TEEK ≈ THERAPEUTIC
note: Therapeutic, healing (un effet thérapeutique).

hook: "an-fehk-SYEUH": a boy with a red nose lets out a giant ACHOO into his tissue while his neighbor leans away: colds are INFECTIOUS: an-fehk-SYEUH ≈ INFECTIOUS
note: Infectious (une maladie infectieuse); for laughter, say contagieux.

hook: "an-sahn-SEEBL": a girl tickles the toes of her brother's plaster cast with a feather, but he feels nothing: INSENSIBLE: an-sahn-SEEBL ≈ IN-SENSE-IBLE
note: Numb, unable to feel (insensible au froid = not feeling the cold); of a person, insensitive, unfeeling (negative). False friend: not 'senseless, foolish'.
